# About Open Source Europe
Open Source Europe provides fiscal hosting for open source communities in the EU.

## Who We Serve
We serve open source projects and maintainers across Europe today.

## Eligibility Requirements
Projects must be open source and based in the European Union to qualify.

# Payouts
How and when the foundation reimburses verified projects for their costs.

## Payout Schedule
Approved reimbursements follow this timeline:

- Within seven days for verified projects with complete documentation on file
- Within fourteen days for all other requests pending a manual compliance review
